title: 4.4 There Is and There Are
unit_outcome: Name rooms and things at home, say where things are, talk about your morning and chores, and say the day, the time and the month.
goal: Say what there is with Es gibt: Es gibt einen Computer im Wohnzimmer. Es gibt drei Bücher.
grammar_function: Es gibt + ein/eine/einen + noun; der-words take einen. Es gibt + number + plural.
speaking_outcome: Say what there is in a room.
